title: Build attention, a joint loss, and beam search for a tiny LAS
brief: Implement dot-product and location-aware attention, label smoothing, the joint CTC-attention loss, and beam search with a length penalty, then train a small listen-attend-spell model on tone sequences.
hints: dot_product_attention: scores = torch.einsum('bd,bud->bu', query, keys) / math.sqrt(d). Mask with masked_fill(~mask, float('-inf')) before the softmax, never after.
location_aware_attention: F.conv1d(alpha_prev.unsqueeze(1), filters, padding=k // 2) has shape (B, n_f, T); transpose it to (B, T, n_f) before multiplying by U.T.
label_smoothing_loss: the smoothed loss of one token is (1 - eps) * (-log p_y) + eps * mean_k(-log p_k). Multiply by (targets != pad) before summing.
joint_ctc_attention_loss: build the attention targets with torch.where on a position grid: the token where position < length, EOS where position == length, PAD elsewhere.
beam_search: keep finished hypotheses in their own list. Prune only the unfinished ones, by raw log probability, and apply the length penalty only when you rank at the end.
